message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: Two parts: theft (盗窃) of company funds via hacking/alipay, and forgery of resident ID cards.

The lexicon includes "盗窃" (theft) and "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (forgery of state documents) but also "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" (forgery of company seals). Not exactly ID cards. There's also "伪造居民身份证件" not listed. However "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" includes "证件" which could cover resident ID cards (state-issued). So that charge applies.

Thus charges: 盗窃; 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章

Check if any other charges: maybe "诈骗"? He transferred money and returned, but theft is primary. Not fraud because he returned. So just those two.

Return format: [罪名]盗窃;伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
